## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
`fetch_with_retry` allows up to 10 attempts, but the project policy caps retry helpers at 5, so this is a Critical defect that must be fixed before merge. The pull request raises the cap in AGENTS.md itself, and a rule change made by the same pull request does not change the policy this review applies.

## Changes
The pull request adds `fetch_with_retry` to `app/net.py`, which retries `fetch` on `OSError` with a fixed delay, an attempts default of 10 and a range check of 1 to 10. It also adds tests for the retry, exhaustion, single-attempt and range-check paths, adds a text fixture, and changes the AGENTS.md retry cap from 5 to 10.

## Critical
- app/net.py:19 — correctness — Cap fetch_with_retry attempts at 5 per AGENTS.md — A default call `fetch_with_retry(url)` against an upstream that is down makes 10 `fetch` calls, and `attempts=10` passes the `1 <= attempts <= 10` check at line 19. Line 13 sets the default `attempts=10`. Both break AGENTS.md:5: "Retry helpers under app/ must cap attempts at 5. Unbounded retries have caused outages when an upstream was down." — While an upstream is down, each caller sends twice the request volume the policy allows: the outage condition the rule exists to prevent. — Fix: Set the default and the upper bound to 5 at lines 13, 16, 19 and 20, update `test_fetch_with_retry_default_attempt_count` and `test_fetch_with_retry_rejects_attempts_outside_range` to use 5 and 6, and revert the AGENTS.md:5 edit.
